descriptor: Interaction studio for buttons with pull

voice.summary: Polarpaw sounds like a studio that obsesses over how a button feels under a thumb: playful, precise and fond of physical metaphors such as pull, press and ripple.
dos: Describe interaction in verbs of touch and motion
Offer a keyboard twin for every effect
Keep copy short and a little cheeky

boilerplate: Polarpaw is a small interaction design studio that builds magnetic, rippling and press-and-hold controls, with every effect tested for keyboard, touch and reduced-motion users.
